ms.report:
Report

SPO banning, unbanning and federation fallback in Heimdall
Each epoch, Heimdall derives the SPO roster from the on-chain registry, runs a FROST DKG, and threshold-signs the treasury movement.

Banning
A peer that publishes conflicting DKG payloads is equivocating, which is provable. The fault is detected and reported in https://github.com/lantr-io/heimdall/blob/main/src/epoch/dkg.rs (report_round1_faults, report_round2_faults, report_round1_equivocations, publish_detected_fault), minted as a FaultProof token bound to that pool and evidence, and applied by build_apply_ban_tx in https://github.com/lantr-io/heimdall/blob/main/src/cardano/apply_ban.rs, which burns the token so the evidence cannot be reused. The ban list is an on-chain linked list read by https://github.com/lantr-io/heimdall/blob/main/src/cardano/ban_list.rs.

Unbanning
There is no unban transaction: a ban carries a ban_until_time and simply expires (ban_duration, is_banned in ban_list.rs), doubling per repeat offence and turning permanent after the configured limit. Roster derivation in https://github.com/lantr-io/heimdall/blob/main/src/cardano/dkg_roster.rs subtracts active bans at the epoch boundary, so an expired pool reappears automatically.

Testing of Banning/Unbanning
We created an injection failure ( flag --inject-fault=equivocate-round1) and started 3 SPOs on preprod, one with injection=failure, the other two without. The two SPOs discovered an incorrect reply and banned the injected instance, continuing the DKG ceremony without it. The log of the experiment with commented transactions: 
https://github.com/lantr-io/heimdall/blob/main/docs/reports/m4-ban-scenario.md

Federation mode
If the surviving subset fails the quorum gate (quorum_ok in dkg_roster.rs: threshold participants and more than 51% stake), the DKG aborts and the treasury movement is signed under the federation key via sign_tm_federation_leaf in https://github.com/lantr-io/heimdall/blob/main/src/bitcoin/tm_builder.rs.
